test: empty board shows the empty state
rationale: The failure is a connection error: `apiRequestContext.post: connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:3999`, and the diff shows `playwright.config.ts` was changed to hardcode `baseURL: "http://127.0.0.1:3999"` instead of using the configured `PORT`. The test never reached the app; the server was not listening on 3999, so this is a test-environment/configuration mismatch rather than a product regression or flaky timing issue. Both attempts failed instantly (0.0s), consistent with an unreachable endpoint.
recommendedAction: Revert the hardcoded `baseURL` in `playwright.config.ts` to use the configured `PORT` (or start the app on port 3999), then rerun the test to confirm the empty-state assertions pass.
